sql: SELECT min(d.value) AS nilai_terkecil FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: berapa nilai deal terbesar?
sql: SELECT max(d.value) AS nilai_terbesar FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: deal paling besar di pipeline
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') ORDER BY d.value DESC LIMIT 1

question: median nilai semua deal
sql: SELECT median(d.value) AS median_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: p90 durasi aktivitas
sql: SELECT quantile(0.9)(a.duration_minutes) AS p90_durasi FROM activities AS a

question: sales di tim Inbound, tampilkan semua
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.team = 'Inbound'

question: deal Migration yg sudah won, nilainya 100 ribu ke atas
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.title LIKE 'Migration%' AND d.stage = 'won' AND d.value >= 100000

question: tiket yang sudah punya waktu resolusi lebih dari 72 jam
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL AND t.resolution_time_hours > 72

question: total nilai deal New Logo yang masih di pipeline
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.title LIKE 'New Logo%' AND d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: jumlah deal Upsell atau Expansion
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE (d.title LIKE 'Upsell%' OR d.title LIKE 'Expansion%')

question: bandingkan total pipeline mentah dengan forecast-nya
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS total_pipeline, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: omset deal Upsell + Expansion vs omset deal Renewal
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won' AND (d.title LIKE 'Upsell%' OR d.title LIKE 'Expansion%')) AS omset_upsell_expansion, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won' AND d.title LIKE 'Renewal%') AS omset_renewal FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: jumlah deal won dan lost per tim
sql: SELECT r.team, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: win rate tiap tim sales
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: brp tiket yg belum selesai dan yg belum ada waktu resolusinya?
sql: SELECT countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS tiket_terbuka, countIf(t.resolution_time_hours IS NULL) AS tiket_tanpa_resolusi FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: rata-rata jam resolusi tiket urgent dibanding yang low
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'urgent'), 2) AS rata_rata_urgent, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'low'), 2) AS rata_rata_low FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: rasio aktivitas bersentimen negatif per tipe
sql: SELECT a.type, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count(), 2) AS rasio_negatif FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type

question: jumlah demo dan meeting per sales
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(a.type = 'demo') AS jumlah_demo, countIf(a.type = 'meeting') AS jumlah_meeting FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: rasio churn tiap segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count(), 2) AS rasio_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: per segmen: jumlah customer aktif, lead, dan prospect
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_aktif, countIf(c.status = 'lead') AS jumlah_lead, countIf(c.status = 'prospect') AS jumlah_prospect FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: rasio sentimen positif dari semua aktivitas tiap sales
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') / count(), 2) AS rasio_positif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: forecast pipeline untuk deal Upsell dan Expansion saja
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, (d.title LIKE 'Upsell%' OR d.title LIKE 'Expansion%')) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: per tim: total pipeline, forecast berbobot, dan omset won sekaligus
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS total_pipeline, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: jumlah deal open dan closed (won/lost) tiap segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS jumlah_open, countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) AS jumlah_closed FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: tiket high+urgent vs low+medium per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(t.priority IN ('high','urgent')) AS tiket_prioritas_tinggi, countIf(t.priority IN ('low','medium')) AS tiket_prioritas_rendah FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: berapa deal Upsell, Expansion, dan Renewal yang won?
sql: SELECT countIf(d.title LIKE 'Upsell%') AS jumlah_upsell, countIf(d.title LIKE 'Expansion%') AS jumlah_expansion, countIf(d.title LIKE 'Renewal%') AS jumlah_renewal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: omset won vs nilai yg lost untuk deal Migration
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost') AS total_nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.title LIKE 'Migration%'

question: rasio tiket yg belum ada waktu resolusi per prioritas
sql: SELECT t.priority, round(countIf(t.resolution_time_hours IS NULL) / count(), 2) AS rasio_belum_resolusi FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority

question: rata-rata durasi call yang positif vs negatif
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.sentiment = 'positive'), 2) AS rata_rata_positif, round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.sentiment = 'negative'), 2) AS rata_rata_negatif FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call'

question: win rate per tipe deal: Upsell, Expansion, dan New Logo
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.title LIKE 'Upsell%') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.title LIKE 'Upsell%'), 2) AS win_rate_upsell, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.title LIKE 'Expansion%') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.title LIKE 'Expansion%'), 2) AS win_rate_expansion, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.title LIKE 'New Logo%') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.title LIKE 'New Logo%'), 2) AS win_rate_new_logo FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: deal pipeline di tiap wilayah sales: nilai mentah dan nilai terbobot
sql: SELECT r.region, sumIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS total_pipeline, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region

question: jumlah customer high-value yang aktif dan yang churn
sql: SELECT countIf(c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_aktif, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS jumlah_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'high-value')

question: berapa deal yang produknya Security-Plus: won dan lost
sql: SELECT countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus')

question: jumlah tiket resolved/closed per bulan tahun ini
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, countIf(t.status IN ('resolved','closed')) AS tiket_selesai FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: rata-rata nilai deal won vs lost per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rata_rata_won, round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost'), 2) AS rata_rata_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: sales mana yg rasio deal lost-nya lebih dari 0.4? sertakan rasionya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS rasio_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0 AND countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0.4

question: jumlah aktivitas demo, meeting, call, email per bulan tahun ini
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, countIf(a.type = 'demo') AS jumlah_demo, countIf(a.type = 'meeting') AS jumlah_meeting, countIf(a.type = 'call') AS jumlah_call, countIf(a.type = 'email') AS jumlah_email FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: brp deal pipeline yang probabilitasnya 70 ke atas dan yg di bawah 70?
sql: SELECT countIf(d.probability >= 70) AS jumlah_tinggi, countIf(d.probability < 70) AS jumlah_rendah FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())

question: berapa omset bulan ini?
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: deal Upsell dan Expansion yang won bulan lalu, tampilkan
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND (d.title LIKE 'Upsell%' OR d.title LIKE 'Expansion%') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())

question: forecast dari deal pipeline yang dibuat 3 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.created_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 3)

question: tiket urgent bulan lalu
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND t.created_at < toStartOfMonth(today())

question: demo minggu ini ada brp?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_demo FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(today(), 1)

question: jumlah deal yang ditutup 30 hari terakhir
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= subtractDays(now(), 30)

question: total omset kuartal lalu per tim
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY r.team

question: rata-rata lama closing deal won (hari) per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_rata_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment

question: umur rata-rata deal pipeline dalam hari
sql: SELECT round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, now())), 2) AS rata_rata_umur_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: tiket yang belum resolved dan umurnya lebih dari 30 hari
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.resolution_time_hours IS NULL AND dateDiff('day', t.created_at, now()) > 30

question: omset YTD tahun ini
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())

question: omset tahun ini vs periode yang sama tahun lalu
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_ytd, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS omset_ytd_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: omset per minggu selama 8 minggu terakhir
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(d.closed_date, 1) AS minggu, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractWeeks(now(), 8) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: nilai deal won terbesar dan terkecil bulan lalu
sql: SELECT max(d.value) AS nilai_terbesar, min(d.value) AS nilai_terkecil FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())

question: call bersentimen negatif kemarin
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call' AND a.sentiment = 'negative' AND toDate(a.timestamp) = yesterday()

question: jam rata2 resolusi tiket yg dibuat bulan ini
sql: SELECT round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: pelanggan baru bulan lalu yg berstatus prospect
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'prospect' AND c.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < toStartOfMonth(today())

question: omset per bulan khusus deal Renewal, setahun terakhir
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.title LIKE 'Renewal%' AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 12) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: deal yang dibuat tahun 2025 dan masih open (belum ada closed_date), brp?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE toYear(d.created_date) = 2025 AND d.closed_date IS NULL

question: rata2, min, max durasi aktivitas tiap tipe
sql: SELECT a.type, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, min(a.duration_minutes) AS durasi_terpendek, max(a.duration_minutes) AS durasi_terpanjang FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type

question: forecast pipeline tiap tim hanya untuk deal Upsell dan Expansion
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND (d.title LIKE 'Upsell%' OR d.title LIKE 'Expansion%') GROUP BY r.team

question: deal pipeline yang produk terakhirnya Analytics-Suite, tampilkan
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.products_involved[-1] = 'Analytics-Suite'

question: hitung pelanggan dengan tag high-value atau tag yg berawalan 'fin'
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'high-value') OR arrayExists(x -> startsWith(x, 'fin'), c.tags)

question: jumlah deal pipeline per stage yg probabilitasnya minimal 50, plus yg di bawah 50
sql: SELECT d.stage, countIf(d.probability >= 50) AS jumlah_tinggi, countIf(d.probability < 50) AS jumlah_rendah FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.stage

question: omset won vs forecast pipeline untuk tiap segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment
